value.evidence: The agency angle and the multi-show benefit survived the rewrite, but the run delivered zero of one requested email.

customer_effort.evidence: Default objective, automatic audience and default Fast policy in the UI. No extra fields or overrides.

human_work.evidence: There was no final asset to review. The baseline was kept without an operator edit.

reliability.evidence: Both drafts were blocked after fresh source review. Exact required offer conditions did not reach the reviewer as citable passages.

economics.evidence: 20 completed model calls and approximately 12 minutes 19 seconds of processing yielded no deliverable. Generation reused compiled knowledge.

usability.evidence: Real UI used for brand creation, preparation, generation and final status. The chosen signup page opens. No final text or HTML asset, so mobile and export could not be exercised.

reuse.evidence: Compiled knowledge was reused by this generation. A subsequent campaign was not run.
